sentences.en: They referred to Chaucer as the father of English poetry.
sentences.zh: 他们称乔叟为英语诗歌之父。

sentences.en: Rhyme and meter form the essential rules of Chinese poetry.
sentences.zh: 押韵和格律构成了中国诗歌的基本规则。

sentences.en: Li Bai's work is the most famous of Chinese poetry.
sentences.zh: 李白的作品是中国诗歌中最著名的。

senses.zh: 诗篇, 诗歌, 诗集 - 作诗法, 诗歌艺术 - 诗情, 诗意, 诗一般的美
